command: (review only -- the claim is the artifact)

assumptions: removing a bridge disconnects the nerve, so it lies on no cycle and appears in no cycle-basis vector
observed_result.question_for_the_reviewer: Is the AUROC cap argument airtight, or does it assume the defect model I happened to use?
observed_result.statement: An overlap that lies in no cycle (a bridge) carries zero holonomy information: every cycle in the nerve has the same holonomy whether that overlap is defective or not. EVERY cycle-based instrument is blind to it, not approximately but identically, and the achievable AUROC is capped by the nerve before any method runs.

typed_remainders.comparison: a review binds a reading of an argument to a commit; it does not bind a number to a measurement, and it cannot promote this claim
